description:
Update Beadwork CLI copy, completions, and package README for goal mode.

## Background

Aliases still say "Run a bounded epic loop". Completions still offer workers/until/noSpawn. Docs describe tmux workers.

## Files

- `command-aliases.ts`, `command-completions.ts`
- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/README.md` and `docs/` worker/tmux pages: rewrite or mark removed
- root examples if they mention delegate/tmux

## Success criteria

- `/bw run` help is epic-only.
- No tmux worker instructions as current behavior.
- Migration notes: removed flags, removed tools, use orchestrate.

## Test plan

- Completions tests.
- Grep tests for forbidden strings in command descriptions.

## Considerations

Full published migration guide can wait for phase D; this issue should not leave operators following tmux docs as if they were current on the cutover branch.
title: Update Beadwork CLI help, completions, and in-tree worker docs
